propositions: Packaged CLI author guides contain dangling consumer-relative cross-references (e.g., review-policy.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md) that break for repo-less clients.
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT) has no CLI-discoverable home; only rebar verify-commit-ticket --help documents it, and nothing directs users there.
Packaged guides must repoint internal links to either sibling guides (rebar explain <topic>) or canonical hosted URLs (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/) so they resolve offline.
A new packaged guide src/rebar/_guides/commit-ticket-trailer.md must be added, registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES, and discoverable via rebar explain commit-trailer and MCP tools.
A link-resolution guard test must validate that no packaged guide or CLI-served criterion contains consumer-relative paths, bare repo paths, or broken rebar explain references.
The MCP explain_criterion tool docstring must list all AUTHOR_GUIDES topics so all guides are discoverable to MCP clients.
